item.title: Egor Demin sets NBA rookie 3-point record as Nets snap 7-game skid with 109-99 win over Jazz
item.description: SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — Egor Demin set an NBA rookie record by making a 3-pointer in his 34th straight game and finished with 25 points and 10 rebounds to help the Brooklyn Nets snap a seven-game losing streak with a 109-99 victory over the Utah Jazz

item.title: Nuggets' Nikola Jokic returns to lineup against Clippers in 1st game since knee injury on Dec. 29
item.description: DENVER (AP) — The Denver Nuggets finally have some beneficial news on the injury front — big man Nikola Jokic is back on the court.

item.title: Suns sweep back-to-back, ending Cavaliers' winning streak at 5 with 126-113 victory
item.description: PHOENIX (AP) — Dillon Brooks scored 27 points and the Phoenix Suns beat Cleveland 126-113 on Friday night to sweep a back-to-back and end the Cavaliers' winning streak at a season-best five games.

item.title: Cade Cunningham leads Pistons past Warriors 131-124 with 29 points, 11 assists
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — Cade Cunningham had 29 points and 11 assists and the Detroit Pistons jumped to a big lead early before holding off the Golden State Warriors for a 131-124 win Friday night.

item.title: Conservatives vote to keep Pierre Poilievre as leader after speech in Calgary
item.description: CALGARY — Pierre Poilievre's position as Conservative leader was cemented Friday after 87.4 per cent of delegates voted in a mandatory leadership review to keep him at the helm of their party.

item.title: At least 200 killed in coltan mine collapse in eastern Congo, rebel authorities say
item.description: GOMA, Congo (AP) — At least 200 people were killed earlier this week when a landslide collapsed several mines at a major coltan mining site in eastern Congo, rebel authorities said Saturday.

item.title: Warriors star Stephen Curry exits with sore right knee that has bothered him for about a week
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — Stephen Curry has been bothered by a sore right knee over the past week and the injury limited him to three quarters in the Golden State Warriors' 131-124 loss to the Detroit Pistons on Friday night.

item.title: Bane scores 32 as Magic rally to beat Raptors 130-120
item.description: ORLANDO, Fla. (AP) — Desmond Bane scored 16 of his 32 points in the fourth quarter to help the Orlando Magic overcome a 13-point deficit and beat the Toronto Raptors 130-120 on Friday night.
